lines: Choose a structure for me to build.
Assign me to Builder before choosing a construction job.
Builders do not use assigned job sites. I will travel between storage and the construction site.
I do not know that structure.
That structure is not available right now.
{structure} needs {blocks} blocks. The blueprint is {blueprint_cost}; construction will cost {cost}. I will need {materials}.
I cannot start {structure}: {reason}.
Choose and preview a structure before buying a blueprint.
I am already working on {structure}.
I need {cost} in your inventory or my assigned payment box before I can start building {structure}.
I need {blueprint_cost} from you before I can draw up a blueprint for {structure}.
Here is the blueprint for {structure}. Place and rotate it where you want; construction will cost {cost} when you hand it to a builder.
Hold the construction blueprint when you ask me to start.
That blueprint is expired.
That blueprint has already started a construction job.
That blueprint is already completed.
I will build {structure} at {site}. I have marked the materials and payment.
I will build {structure} at {site}. I still need {materials}, so I will wait by assigned storage within {storage_radius} blocks of the build site.
I am building {structure}: {placed} of {blocks} blocks placed.
Construction cancelled.
Construction cancelled. I returned {cost} because no blocks were placed.
I need more construction materials for {structure}: {materials}. Put them in assigned storage within {storage_radius} blocks of the build site or my job inventory.
I need {materials} for {structure}, so I am heading to assigned storage to restock.
I am at assigned storage waiting for {materials} to build {structure}.
I am collecting construction materials from assigned storage.
I need room in my job inventory to carry construction materials. I will dump excavation output first, but other protected items may still be blocking space.
I found the needed construction materials in assigned storage, but I cannot reach that container.
I still need {materials} for {structure}. I cannot reach assigned storage to wait for them.
I do not have a build site for this structure.
I cannot find a safe place nearby for that structure.
{structure} is too large for the current builder limit.
The planned build site is outside my assigned work area.
The planned build site is too far from us.
Part of the planned build site is not loaded.
Something important is already at {target}, so I will not replace it.
The next block at {target} needs support before I can place it.
Someone or something is standing where I need to build at {target}.
I cannot reach the next construction spot at {target}.
I need the right tool to clear the block at {target} before I can keep building {structure}.
I need a {tool} to prepare the next construction block at {target} for {structure}.
I am moving to the next construction spot at {target}.
I could not place the next block at {target}.
I placed the next block for {structure}: {placed} of {blocks}.
{structure} is complete.
